proposal.observation: Round 1 improved the scaled proxy from 0.6225 to 0.6531 and reduced the recentring residual from 35.0 cm to 1.5 cm. Orientation remains healthy, depth NaNs fell from 25.9% to 21.1%, phase incoherence fell from 25.9 to 18.1 degrees, and real detections rose from 40.0% to 63.6%. The remaining defect is prompt geometry: 11 points are produced for 10 expected rings (ring-count error 0.1), x-spacing CV remains 0.354, and the artifact shows an extra non-synthetic vertical candidate plus a mixture of oblique, midpoint, and fallback prompts.
proposal.failure_mode: A spurious real vertical detection and insufficiently coherent oblique-line support produce one extra, irregularly spaced prompt, causing stage-4 pattern mismatch and downstream crop inconsistency.
proposal.rationale: The centreline and radial coverage are now healthy enough to tune detection. The successful round-1 unfolding and T4 radial prior are retained. Raising the vertical Hough threshold to 5000 suppresses the extra real vertical and selects deterministic synthetic ring-centre verticals; moderately relaxing oblique detection and increasing its line-gap allowance should recover coherent real joint evidence across depth-map gaps. Tightening pattern tolerance rejects inconsistent intersections instead of admitting an eleventh prompt.
